title: Seazn Match Day code open, v1: POST /api/v1/match-day-code/fixtures/{id}/scoring-link
description: What a phone holding a Match Day code gets when it opens a match (capture S4 Match Day design 2026-11-07 §6, §9.4; MD-1 Task 4), authenticated by Authorization: Bearer md_… only, with no body. The answer is `data` in the v1 envelope {ok: true, data, requestId}; $defs.refusal is `error` in {ok: false, error, requestId}. Vendored into the capture repo; its sha256, parity with its zod twin and its fixtures are pinned by apps/web/src/server/api-v1/__tests__/capture-contract.test.ts.

kind.description: link (the match's scoring link) or finished (the match is finalized or cancelled: there is nothing to score, and nothing was written).

url.description: link only: the match's own Remote scoring link, https://{host}/score/dl_{43 base64url}, the printed QR's when the match has one. Re-shown on every open, never a second link beside a live one, and nothing is revoked. A credential: the phone hands it to its scoring pad and stores it as a scan of that QR would be.

sport_key.description: link only: the match's sport: it decides which pad the phone opens.

kind.description: link (the match's scoring link) or finished (the match is finalized or cancelled: there is nothing to score, and nothing was written).

refusal.description: Every refusal, the envelope's error: 401 MD_UNKNOWN (no such code, or no md_ bearer), 410 MD_WITHDRAWN, 410 MD_ENDED, 403 MD_NOT_OPEN (with opens_at), 403 MD_OUT_OF_SCOPE (the match is not in the code's competition, venue or courts, or not on its day, or its division is archived, at the moment of asking). A 404 NOT_FOUND (no such match) and a 429 RATE_LIMITED (with Retry-After) are the v1 envelope's own answers, outside this shape.

code.description: The machine word the phone keys its copy on: one of the plan's MD_ words, a closed list. The v1 envelope's own answers (429 RATE_LIMITED, 404 NOT_FOUND, 500 INTERNAL) are not md_ refusals and are outside this shape; the phone reads them by status.

message.description: A plain English developer string; the phone never shows it.

opens_at.description: MD_NOT_OPEN only: when the code's day starts, as a UTC instant.
